description: CorePasteboardFlavorType 0x75743136 from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened file:///private/tmp/rclip-capture/page.html (h1, a paragraph with bold/italic and a link, a 3-row bordered table), used the Find bar to move focus into the page, then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: Byte-identical to the modern UTI's data: AppKit publishes the legacy NSPasteboardType name and the UTI as two names for one representation.
